verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents its own automation. Pipelines lets users "create powerful, automated workflows," which can "trigger AI-powered workflows" to automate tasks. Commits that include issue keys update Jira statuses automatically, and customizable merge checks enforce policies. However, the evidence never describes a general rule engine where users define event conditions and resulting actions, and event triggers are only implied through CI/CD. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of user-defined event→action rules (trigger types, conditions, actions), coverage of non-pipeline events such as PR or issue events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
